item.title: Indian River County responds to waste management condo fee spike in Vero Beach
item.description: A Vero Beach condo owner saw his monthly waste management fees jump from $11 to $21 under a new county contract. County officials say the increase brings additional services but acknowledge the impact on residents.

item.title: St. Lucie County offers free rip current safety training at local pools this summer
item.description: St. Lucie County Parks and Recreation will host three free sessions using a new rip current simulation machine at local public pools. The training aims to teach proper escape techniques in a controlled environment.

item.title: Three lawsuits challenge Florida property tax amendment ballot language ahead of November vote
item.description: Florida's property tax amendment faces legal challenges over whether the ballot language fairly explains the measure or acts as a political sales pitch. A hearing is set for July 29.

item.title: Three lawsuits challenge Florida property tax amendment before November vote
item.description: Three separate lawsuits filed by nonprofit Save Our Voters, former South Miami Mayor Philip Stoddard, and former lawmakers Jeff Brandes and Al Lawson challenge whether Amendment Three's ballot language gives voters a fair explanation or a political sales pitch.

item.title: Lionel Messi leads Argentina to 3-2 comeback victory over Egypt in World Cup round of 16
item.description: Lionel Messi scored his eighth goal of the tournament and led Argentina to an improbable 3-2 victory over Egypt on Tuesday despite trailing by two with only 11 minutes of regulation time to play.

item.title: United States eliminated from World Cup after 4-1 loss to Belgium
item.description: The United States hopes for a deep World Cup run at home ended when Charles De Ketelaere scored twice and assisted on another goal, helping Belgium defeat the Americans 4-1 on Monday night in the round of 16.

item.title: Monday's US-Belgium World Cup match draws biggest soccer audience in US history
item.description: Monday's United States-Belgium World Cup match drew more than 30 million viewers, making it the most-watched soccer telecast in U.S. history, Fox Sports reported.

item.title: IOC ends neutral status vetting for Russian athletes ahead of 2028 LA Olympics
item.description: The International Olympic Committee advised Olympic sports bodies on Tuesday to end a three-year program vetting Russians for neutral status ahead of qualifying events for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.

item.description:

item.title: Colorado State University reduces 2026 Atlantic hurricane season forecast
item.description: Colorado State University lowered its 2026 Atlantic hurricane season forecast due to a strong El Niño pattern.

item.title: Former Florida gubernatorial candidate Andrew Gillum arrested on drug possession charges in Alabama
item.description: Andrew Gillum, who narrowly lost the 2018 Florida governor's race to Ron DeSantis, was arrested on marijuana and methamphetamine possession charges after a traffic stop in Daphne, Alabama.

item.title: 85-acre Indrio Town Center development near I-95 faces pushback from St. Lucie County neighbors
item.description: A proposed 85-acre mixed-use development off Indrio Road and Russakis Road in St. Lucie County is moving toward reality after county planning and zoning unanimously recommended rezoning the agricultural land. County commissioners are expected to vote on the rezoning in August.
